mapper.select: /* TB_MAIL_ACCOUNT 계정 조회 mail.selectMailAccount */ SELECT ACCOUNT_ID , USER_ID , EMAIL_ADDR , IMAP_HOST , IMAP_PORT , AUTH_TYPE_CD , CREDENTIAL_ENC , CREDENTIAL_IV , KEY_VERSION , USE_YN , LAST_LOGIN_DT , CREATE_DT , UPDATE_DT FROM TB_MAIL_ACCOUNT WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND EMAIL_ADDR = #{emailAddr}

/* TB_MAIL_ACCOUNT userId 기준 최근 로그인 계정 조회 mail.selectMailAccountByUserId */ SELECT ACCOUNT_ID , USER_ID , EMAIL_ADDR , IMAP_HOST , IMAP_PORT , AUTH_TYPE_CD , CREDENTIAL_ENC , CREDENTIAL_IV , KEY_VERSION , USE_YN , LAST_LOGIN_DT , CREATE_DT , UPDATE_DT FROM TB_MAIL_ACCOUNT WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY LAST_LOGIN_DT DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: /* TB_MAIL_ACCOUNT INSERT ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE mail.insertMailAccount */ INSERT INTO TB_MAIL_ACCOUNT ( ACCOUNT_ID, USER_ID, EMAIL_ADDR, IMAP_HOST, IMAP_PORT, AUTH_TYPE_CD, CREDENTIAL_ENC, CREDENTIAL_IV, KEY_VERSION, USE_YN, LAST_LOGIN_DT, CREATE_DT ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{userId}, #{emailAddr}, #{imapHost}, #{imapPort}, #{authTypeCd}, #{credentialEnc}, #{credentialIv}, #{keyVersion}, 'Y', NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE IMAP_HOST = VALUES(IMAP_HOST), IMAP_PORT = VALUES(IMAP_PORT), CREDENTIAL_ENC = VALUES(CREDENTIAL_ENC), CREDENTIAL_IV = VALUES(CREDENTIAL_IV), KEY_VERSION = VALUES(KEY_VERSION), LAST_LOGIN_DT = NOW(), UPDATE_DT = NOW()

/* TB_MAIL_MSG INSERT mail.insertMailMsg */ INSERT INTO TB_MAIL_MSG ( MAIL_ID, ACCOUNT_ID, FOLDER_CD, IMAP_UID, MSG_ID_HEADER, IN_REPLY_TO, SUBJECT, FROM_ADDR, FROM_NAME, TO_ADDR_JSON, CC_ADDR_JSON, MAIL_DT, BODY_TEXT, DELETED_YN, CREATE_DT ) VALUES ( #{mailId}, #{accountId}, #{folderCd}, #{imapUid}, #{msgIdHeader}, #{inReplyTo}, #{subject}, #{fromAddr}, #{fromName}, #{toAddrJson}, #{ccAddrJson}, #{mailDt}, #{bodyText}, 'N', NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE MSG_ID_HEADER = VALUES(MSG_ID_HEADER), IN_REPLY_TO = VALUES(IN_REPLY_TO)
mapper.select: /* TB_MAIL_MSG ID 조회 mail.selectMailMsgById */ SELECT M.MAIL_ID , M.ACCOUNT_ID , M.FOLDER_CD , M.IMAP_UID , M.MSG_ID_HEADER , M.IN_REPLY_TO , M.SUBJECT , M.FROM_ADDR , M.FROM_NAME , M.TO_ADDR_JSON , M.CC_ADDR_JSON , M.MAIL_DT , M.BODY_TEXT , M.DELETED_YN , M.CREATE_DT FROM TB_MAIL_MSG M WHERE M.MAIL_ID = #{mailId} AND M.DELETED_YN = 'N'

/* TB_MAIL_AI_ANALYSIS 조회 mail.selectMailAiAnalysis */ SELECT MAIL_ID , MAIL_PURPOSE_CD , ACTION_REQUIRED_CD , URGENCY_CD , IMPORTANCE_CD , WORK_CATEGORY_CD , DUE_DT , SUMMARY , REPLY_EXPECTED_YN , EXPECTED_REPLY_DUE_DT , ACTION_COMPLETE_YN , ACTION_COMPLETE_DT , ANALYZED_DT FROM TB_MAIL_AI_ANALYSIS WHERE MAIL_ID = #{mailId}
mapper.insert: /* TB_MAIL_AI_ANALYSIS INSERT mail.insertMailAiAnalysis */ INSERT INTO TB_MAIL_AI_ANALYSIS ( MAIL_ID, MAIL_PURPOSE_CD, ACTION_REQUIRED_CD, URGENCY_CD, IMPORTANCE_CD, WORK_CATEGORY_CD, DUE_DT, SUMMARY, REPLY_EXPECTED_YN, EXPECTED_REPLY_DUE_DT, ACTION_COMPLETE_YN, ANALYZED_DT ) VALUES ( #{mailId}, #{mailPurposeCd}, #{actionRequiredCd}, #{urgencyCd}, #{importanceCd}, #{workCategoryCd}, #{dueDt}, #{summary}, COALESCE(#{replyExpectedYn}, 'N'), #{expectedReplyDueDt}, 'N', NOW() )
mapper.select: /* 분류된 메일함 건수 mail.selectClassifiedMailCount */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MAIL_MSG M JOIN TB_MAIL_AI_ANALYSIS A ON M.MAIL_ID = A.MAIL_ID

/* 분류된 메일함 목록 mail.selectClassifiedMailList */ SELECT M.MAIL_ID , M.IMAP_UID , M.SUBJECT , M.FROM_ADDR , M.FROM_NAME , M.MAIL_DT , M.BODY_TEXT , M.FOLDER_CD , A.MAIL_PURPOSE_CD , CP.CODE_NM AS mailPurposeNm , A.ACTION_REQUIRED_CD , CA.CODE_NM AS actionRequiredNm , A.URGENCY_CD , CU.CODE_NM AS urgencyNm , A.IMPORTANCE_CD , CI.CODE_NM AS importanceNm , A.WORK_CATEGORY_CD , CW.CODE_NM AS workCategoryNm , A.DUE_DT , A.SUMMARY , A.ACTION_COMPLETE_YN FROM TB_MAIL_MSG M JOIN TB_MAIL_AI_ANALYSIS A ON M.MAIL_ID = A.MAIL_ID LEFT JOIN TB_CODE CP ON A.MAIL_PURPOSE_CD = CP.CODE_ID AND CP.CODE_GRP_ID = 'ML000001' LEFT JOIN TB_CODE CA ON A.ACTION_REQUIRED_CD = CA.CODE_ID AND CA.CODE_GRP_ID = 'ML000002' LEFT JOIN TB_CODE CU ON A.URGENCY_CD = CU.CODE_ID AND CU.CODE_GRP_ID = 'ML000003' LEFT JOIN TB_CODE CI ON A.IMPORTANCE_CD = CI.CODE_ID AND CI.CODE_GRP_ID = 'ML000004' LEFT JOIN TB_CODE CW ON A.WORK_CATEGORY_CD = CW.CODE_ID AND CW.CODE_GRP_ID = 'ML000008'
ORDER BY M.MAIL_DT DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{pageNum}
/* 최신 회신 초안 조회 mail.selectLatestReplyDraft */ SELECT DRAFT_ID , MAIL_ID , DRAFT_CONTENT , CREATE_DT FROM TB_MAIL_REPLY_DRAFT WHERE MAIL_ID = #{mailId} ORDER BY CREATE_DT DESC LIMIT 1
/* 업무영역 코드 목록 mail.selectWorkCategoryList */ SELECT CODE_ID , CODE_NM FROM TB_CODE WHERE CODE_GRP_ID = 'ML000008' AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_ORD
mapper.sql: FROM TB_MAIL_MSG M LEFT JOIN TB_MAIL_AI_ANALYSIS A ON A.MAIL_ID = M.MAIL_ID LEFT JOIN TB_MAIL_SYNC_STATE S ON S.ACCOUNT_ID = M.ACCOUNT_ID AND S.FOLDER_CD = '002'
mapper.select: /* 보낸메일함 분류 건수 mail.selectSentClassifiedCount */ SELECT COUNT(*)

/* 보낸메일함 분류 목록 mail.selectSentClassifiedList */ SELECT M.MAIL_ID , M.IMAP_UID AS imapUid , S.UID_VALIDITY AS uidValidity , M.SUBJECT , JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(M.TO_ADDR_JSON, '$[0]')) AS toAddrRaw , M.MAIL_DT , COALESCE(A.REPLY_EXPECTED_YN, 'N') AS replyExpectedYn /* repliedYn: IN_REPLY_TO 헤더 기반 회신 수신 여부 */ , CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_MAIL_MSG R WHERE R.IN_REPLY_TO = M.MSG_ID_HEADER AND R.ACCOUNT_ID = M.ACCOUNT_ID AND R.FOLDER_CD = '001' AND R.DELETED_YN = 'N' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS repliedYn /* elapsedDays: 첫 답장 날짜 기준, 없으면 오늘까지 */ , CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_MAIL_MSG R WHERE R.IN_REPLY_TO = M.MSG_ID_HEADER AND R.ACCOUNT_ID = M.ACCOUNT_ID AND R.FOLDER_CD = '001' AND R.DELETED_YN = 'N' ) THEN DATEDIFF( (SELECT MIN(R.MAIL_DT) FROM TB_MAIL_MSG R WHERE R.IN_REPLY_TO = M.MSG_ID_HEADER AND R.ACCOUNT_ID = M.ACCOUNT_ID AND R.FOLDER_CD = '001' AND R.DELETED_YN = 'N'), M.MAIL_DT ) ELSE DATEDIFF(NOW(), M.MAIL_DT) END AS elapsedDays /* replyElapsedHours: 첫 답장까지 소요 시간 */ , (SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, M.MAIL_DT, MIN(R.MAIL_DT)) FROM TB_MAIL_MSG R WHERE R.IN_REPLY_TO = M.MSG_ID_HEADER AND R.ACCOUNT_ID = M.ACCOUNT_ID AND R.FOLDER_CD = '001' AND R.DELETED_YN = 'N') AS replyElapsedHours
ORDER BY M.MAIL_DT DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{pageNum}

/* 보낸메일함 탭별 건수 mail.selectSentTabCounts */ SELECT 'all' AS tabType, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM TB_MAIL_MSG M LEFT JOIN TB_MAIL_AI_ANALYSIS A ON A.MAIL_ID = M.MAIL_ID WHERE M.ACCOUNT_ID = #{accountId} AND M.FOLDER_CD = '002' AND M.DELETED_YN = 'N' AND DATE(M.MAIL_DT) >= #{startDate} AND DATE(M.MAIL_DT) <= #{endDate} UNION ALL SELECT 'pending' AS tabType, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM TB_MAIL_MSG M LEFT JOIN TB_MAIL_AI_ANALYSIS A ON A.MAIL_ID = M.MAIL_ID WHERE M.ACCOUNT_ID = #{accountId} AND M.FOLDER_CD = '002' AND M.DELETED_YN = 'N' AND DATE(M.MAIL_DT) >= #{startDate} AND DATE(M.MAIL_DT) <= #{endDate} AND COALESCE(A.REPLY_EXPECTED_YN, 'N') = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_MAIL_MSG R WHERE R.IN_REPLY_TO = M.MSG_ID_HEADER AND R.ACCOUNT_ID = M.ACCOUNT_ID AND R.FOLDER_CD = '001' AND R.DELETED_YN = 'N' ) UNION ALL SELECT 'done' AS tabType, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM TB_MAIL_MSG M LEFT JOIN TB_MAIL_AI_ANALYSIS A ON A.MAIL_ID = M.MAIL_ID WHERE M.ACCOUNT_ID = #{accountId} AND M.FOLDER_CD = '002' AND M.DELETED_YN = 'N' AND DATE(M.MAIL_DT) >= #{startDate} AND DATE(M.MAIL_DT) <= #{endDate} AND COALESCE(A.REPLY_EXPECTED_YN, 'N') = 'Y' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_MAIL_MSG R WHERE R.IN_REPLY_TO = M.MSG_ID_HEADER AND R.ACCOUNT_ID = M.ACCOUNT_ID AND R.FOLDER_CD = '001' AND R.DELETED_YN = 'N' )

/* 답장 대기 많은 상대 mail.selectTopPendingRecipients */ SELECT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(M.TO_ADDR_JSON, '$[0]')) AS toAddrRaw , COUNT(*) AS pendingCount FROM TB_MAIL_MSG M LEFT JOIN TB_MAIL_AI_ANALYSIS A ON A.MAIL_ID = M.MAIL_ID WHERE M.ACCOUNT_ID = #{accountId} AND M.FOLDER_CD = '002' AND M.DELETED_YN = 'N' AND DATE(M.MAIL_DT) >= #{startDate} AND DATE(M.MAIL_DT) <= #{endDate} AND COALESCE(A.REPLY_EXPECTED_YN, 'N') = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_MAIL_MSG R WHERE R.IN_REPLY_TO = M.MSG_ID_HEADER AND R.ACCOUNT_ID = M.ACCOUNT_ID AND R.FOLDER_CD = '001' AND R.DELETED_YN = 'N' ) GROUP BY JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(M.TO_ADDR_JSON, '$[0]')) ORDER BY pendingCount DESC LIMIT 5

/* 이번 주 / 전주 회신 통계 mail.selectSentWeeklyStats */ SELECT /* 이번 주 — 트래킹 대상: REPLY_EXPECTED_YN = 'Y' */ SUM(CASE WHEN M.MAIL_DT >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m-%d 00:00:00') - INTERVAL (DAYOFWEEK(NOW())-2) DAY AND COALESCE(A.REPLY_EXPECTED_YN,'N') = 'Y' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_MAIL_MSG R WHERE R.IN_REPLY_TO = M.MSG_ID_HEADER AND R.ACCOUNT_ID = M.ACCOUNT_ID AND R.FOLDER_CD = '001' AND R.DELETED_YN = 'N' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS thisWeekDone , SUM(CASE WHEN M.MAIL_DT >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m-%d 00:00:00') - INTERVAL (DAYOFWEEK(NOW())-2) DAY AND COALESCE(A.REPLY_EXPECTED_YN,'N') = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS thisWeekExpected /* avgDays: 첫 번째 답장까지 일수 평균 (IN_REPLY_TO 매칭 기준) */ , AVG(CASE WHEN M.MAIL_DT >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m-%d 00:00:00') - INTERVAL (DAYOFWEEK(NOW())-2) DAY AND COALESCE(A.REPLY_EXPECTED_YN,'N') = 'Y' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_MAIL_MSG R WHERE R.IN_REPLY_TO = M.MSG_ID_HEADER AND R.ACCOUNT_ID = M.ACCOUNT_ID AND R.FOLDER_CD = '001' AND R.DELETED_YN = 'N' ) THEN (SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, M.MAIL_DT, MIN(R.MAIL_DT)) / 24.0 FROM TB_MAIL_MSG R WHERE R.IN_REPLY_TO = M.MSG_ID_HEADER AND R.ACCOUNT_ID = M.ACCOUNT_ID AND R.FOLDER_CD = '001' AND R.DELETED_YN = 'N') ELSE NULL END) AS thisWeekAvgDays /* 전주 */ , SUM(CASE WHEN M.MAIL_DT >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m-%d 00:00:00') - INTERVAL (DAYOFWEEK(NOW())+5) DAY AND M.MAIL_DT < DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m-%d 00:00:00') - INTERVAL (DAYOFWEEK(NOW())-2) DAY AND COALESCE(A.REPLY_EXPECTED_YN,'N') = 'Y' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_MAIL_MSG R WHERE R.IN_REPLY_TO = M.MSG_ID_HEADER AND R.ACCOUNT_ID = M.ACCOUNT_ID AND R.FOLDER_CD = '001' AND R.DELETED_YN = 'N' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prevWeekDone , SUM(CASE WHEN M.MAIL_DT >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m-%d 00:00:00') - INTERVAL (DAYOFWEEK(NOW())+5) DAY AND M.MAIL_DT < DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m-%d 00:00:00') - INTERVAL (DAYOFWEEK(NOW())-2) DAY AND COALESCE(A.REPLY_EXPECTED_YN,'N') = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prevWeekExpected , AVG(CASE WHEN M.MAIL_DT >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m-%d 00:00:00') - INTERVAL (DAYOFWEEK(NOW())+5) DAY AND M.MAIL_DT < DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m-%d 00:00:00') - INTERVAL (DAYOFWEEK(NOW())-2) DAY AND COALESCE(A.REPLY_EXPECTED_YN,'N') = 'Y' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_MAIL_MSG R WHERE R.IN_REPLY_TO = M.MSG_ID_HEADER AND R.ACCOUNT_ID = M.ACCOUNT_ID AND R.FOLDER_CD = '001' AND R.DELETED_YN = 'N' ) THEN (SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, M.MAIL_DT, MIN(R.MAIL_DT)) / 24.0 FROM TB_MAIL_MSG R WHERE R.IN_REPLY_TO = M.MSG_ID_HEADER AND R.ACCOUNT_ID = M.ACCOUNT_ID AND R.FOLDER_CD = '001' AND R.DELETED_YN = 'N') ELSE NULL END) AS prevWeekAvgDays FROM TB_MAIL_MSG M LEFT JOIN TB_MAIL_AI_ANALYSIS A ON A.MAIL_ID = M.MAIL_ID WHERE M.ACCOUNT_ID = #{accountId} AND M.FOLDER_CD = '002' AND M.DELETED_YN = 'N'
